run_pybullet_graphics_server: run a pybullet graphics server simulation loop that steps at 240 Hz
connect_pybullet_graphics_server: connect to a pybullet graphics server using p.connect with GRAPHICS_SERVER mode
step_simulation_loop: run a simulation loop that calls stepSimulation while the client is connected
check_pybullet_connection: check if a pybullet client is connected using p.isConnected in a loop
configure_simulation_timestep: configure the simulation timestep using time.sleep to control frame rate
